notes.title: About Donuts VRGAMES
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34369938/0231029a0e01a0463f12e151cac50408a58b238d.png[/img]

[h1]
[b]■Team[/b][/h1]
We are a small VR team based in Tokyo, in a full Japanese company. 
Composed of multiples nationalities, 
we are developing high quality game on short production time, 
that we hope you will enjoy!


[h1][b]■Game[/b][/h1]
We are about to release a brand new game, 
take a look at our Steam page!
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34369938/7e22ff9eb563ca1516962a00b1ef557fe9293f4c.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34369938/c139063f32d0a1353b6b677f1b7c54c173aaf2db.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1019230/MrHack_Jack_Robot_detective/]Mr hack jack :Robot Detective[/url]


[h1][b]■Twich[/b][/h1]
We stream the development every working day on Twitch!
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34369938/ea0d71f3a558a9508b640eb7bb8fd3f0e6ad7dd5.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34369938/647401a68ec3c9f50a6772d453ee976dce0e8b03.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/donutsvr]Twich[/url]

Please come by and say hi!


--------
[h1][b]■チームについて[/b][/h1]
私たちは、日本・東京に拠点を置くゲームデベロッパーです。
複数の国籍のメンバーで構成されたユニークなチームです。
小さなチーム、短い開発期間で、良い品質のゲームを作ります。


[h1][b]■Game[/b][/h1]
近日、新しいメンバー構成で作ったゲームをリリースします。
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1019230/MrHack_Jack_Robot_detective/]Mr hack jack :Robot Detective[/url]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34369938/7e22ff9eb563ca1516962a00b1ef557fe9293f4c.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34369938/c139063f32d0a1353b6b677f1b7c54c173aaf2db.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1][b]■Twitch[/b][/h1]
Twitchで、毎日開発ストリーミングを行っています。
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34369938/ea0d71f3a558a9508b640eb7bb8fd3f0e6ad7dd5.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34369938/647401a68ec3c9f50a6772d453ee976dce0e8b03.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/donutsvr]Twich[/url]


是非、ご覧ください。
よろしくお願い致します。
